userStories.title: Parity check loop — re-compare and iterate
userStories.description: Re-run the full comparison between makanmoments.cafe (port 3030) and fnb-online-ordering (port 3031) after all fixes. Steps: (1) grep for any remaining localhost:3030 or makanmoments.cafe references, (2) curl all key endpoints on both ports and diff responses, (3) if any differences found, add new user stories to prd.json and set this story back to passes:false, (4) if zero differences, mark passes:true and the loop terminates.
acceptanceCriteria: grep -r 'localhost:3030' in src/ scripts/ and root *.mjs returns zero hits
grep -r 'makanmoments.cafe' in src/ returns zero hits (CLAUDE.md and .env excluded)
All API endpoints return equivalent responses on both ports
All locale routes return 200 on both ports
Zero actionable differences found — loop terminates
technicalNotes: This is the loop termination story — always the last to run
If differences found: create new user stories, set this to passes:false
If no differences: set passes:true — ralph loop ends
